title: What Servant Leadership Actually Costs a Godly Man
caption:
Everyone wants to lead. Almost nobody wants what it actually costs.

Leading looks like a stage. Scripture says it looks like a towel and a basin, kneeling to wash feet nobody else would touch. Taking the job nobody wants, before you're asked, and never bringing it up again. Apologizing first even when it's not fully your fault.

Christ didn't lead from a distance. He led into the cost, all the way to a cross. Every real leader since is just following that pattern.

#faith #leadership #godlyman #christianmen #servantleadership
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
